caption: The drawing depicts a wooden statue with visible grain and vertical cracks running down its length, primarily featuring grayish and brown tones. The figure stands upright on a roughly carved base comprised of several vertical wooden segments. The statue has a human-like face with pale coloration and a small crown or headpiece on top. Two large, curved, horn-like structures, textured and darker in color, extend symmetrically from the figure’s shoulders downward beside the body. The statue’s arms are not distinctly carved but end in rounded, spiral shapes at about the elbow level, resembling coiled ends. The body of the figure is elongated and shrouded in a long, robe-like garment, with simple vertical folds and a slightly widened base. The background is plain and light, and the artist's signature, "V. Van Voris," is present at the bottom right of the image.
title: Carved Statue of the Virgin Mary
